rec.name: PDP Buy Box (Bordered Container with Sticky Option)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally by Christoph and Chris)

what.text: A theme-editor toggle on the product page that wraps the whole product info column (title, price, stock status, add-to-cart button, payment icons, Klarna note) in a visible bordered, optionally background-colored box with rounded corners. An optional 'Sticky Buy Box' setting keeps the box pinned while the customer scrolls past the gallery. This recreates the 'Buy Box' feature of the Focal theme (elbdev) as a section setting.

why.text: Visually grouping the price, availability, CTA and payment/trust icons into one framed unit sets the purchase decision area apart from the rest of the page and focuses attention on the buy action. A card-like container signals 'this is where you act', reduces visual noise and keeps the CTA and reassurance in view. The sticky option keeps the CTA reachable while users read the gallery and description. Mostly a visual-hierarchy effect, so expect a modest lift.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add schema settings: a 'Buy Box' header, the checkboxes enable_buy_box and sticky_buy_box, the color pickers buy_box_border_color and buy_box_background_color, and a border-radius range (0–16px, default 8). 2) In product-info.liquid, inside the .product__info wrapper, conditionally wrap the content in <div class="ed-pdp-buy-box"> when enable_buy_box is on. 3) Output a scoped <style> block: transparent colors fall back to theme background and a mix of background and text color (90%) for the border; colors are exposed as RGB CSS variables (--buybox-border-color / --buybox-background-color). The box gets a 1px border, the chosen radius and 16px padding (12px 8px on mobile ≤767px). If sticky is on, .product__info gets position: sticky with top: 100px. 4) Enable it in the theme editor under Product page > Buy Box.

items: Sticky Buy Box (checkbox, default off; in code, not visible in the screenshots)
Border Color (color; transparent = auto-derived from theme colors)

dependencies.text: Focal-based theme (uses the main-product.liquid section and the product-info.liquid snippet, with .product__info and theme settings.background / settings.text_color and the color_mix filter). No app or metafields needed. The CSS class is ed-pdp-buy-box. Mobile adjustments assume the .product-meta class.

items: Scroll depth / sticky interaction (if sticky is enabled)
